population.eligibility.value: Distinct postings with exact Data Analyst short title, non-null salary_year_avg, remote=1; then require at least one of top3 skills

basis.rationale: Salary is per posting, OR of selected skills; ranking within same eligible cohort
Overall average of distinct jobs requesting any selected skill

measure.denominator.value: number of distinct eligible jobs requiring at least one selected top3 skill; empty set gives NULL

items.quote: Data Analyst, require a non-null annual average salary, and are remote
top three most frequently demanded skills

candidates.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT job_id,salary_year_avg FROM job_postings_fact WHERE job_title_short='Data Analyst' AND salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL AND job_work_from_home=1), links AS (SELECT DISTINCT job_id,skill_id FROM skills_job_dim), frequencies AS (SELECT l.skill_id,count(distinct e.job_id) demand FROM eligible e JOIN links l USING(job_id) GROUP BY l.skill_id), top_skills AS (SELECT skill_id,demand FROM frequencies ORDER BY demand DESC,skill_id LIMIT 3), selected_jobs AS (SELECT e.* FROM eligible e WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM links l JOIN top_skills t USING(skill_id) WHERE l.job_id=e.job_id)) SELECT avg(salary_year_avg) overall_average_salary FROM selected_jobs
